changelog: Logic synced with dusk-rando 0.4.5: per-location key rules (E1M5, E1M6, E1M8, E2M1, E2M3, E2M4, E2M6, E2M7, E3M1, E3M2 checks that need no keys; E2M1's Level Complete needs only the Red Key) and E3M1's Super Shotgun needing the Mortar.
New exorcist combat logic setting (testing): everything outside the seed's first level needs all 10 firearm items.
E2M10: the developer-only east supply room's 28 pickups are gone; the remaining E2M10 checks follow the apworld's new names.
E3M9: Level Complete now has a single pin, on the exit button on the main map (the far-off second exit button and its detached panel are gone).
E1M10: the Fast Fire Totem is now pinned in the boss arena, where it gets teleported in when you press the button near the end (it was drawn out of bounds).
Synced with dusk-rando 0.4.2: E2M1's key is now called "E2M1 - Blue Key".
E2M1: the 16 spare Blue Keys and the Sword are no longer checks and are removed from the map.
E2M1: Level Complete pin moved onto the main map next to Pistol Clip 3 and Shotgun 1 (no more detached panel).
Combat logic setting renamed to match the apworld: easy / normal / unhinged.
The pack now checks GitHub for updates when it loads and offers to install new versions (PopTracker asks once whether to trust raw.githubusercontent.com).
Map follows you: the map tab switches to the level you load into (needs a DuskRando build with level reporting). Toggle: AUTO MAP.
Level Complete pins sit on each level's exits (buttons and loading zones); E3M10's is on the final boss.
Removed the red connector lines between map layers.
Initial pack: maps generated from the game's level layouts, basic logic.
